tasks.label: Start full development environment
tasks.detail: Starts MongoDB, backend (8088), and frontend (3001) via Docker Compose V2. Detects already-running services and port conflicts before starting.

tasks.label: Stop full development environment
tasks.command: sg docker -c "echo 'Stopping...' && docker compose down && echo 'Environment stopped successfully.'"
tasks.detail: Stops all services (MongoDB, backend, frontend) via Docker Compose V2.
